featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Theobroma Café in Borivali, and once again, it proved why it’s one of the best cafés in Mumbai! I tried the Chicken Makhani Sandwich and the Chicken Mayo 🥪 —both were absolutely loaded, bursting with flavor, and made with fresh, soft bread. featured_reviews.name: Ayyub Kolsawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
This doesnt need any introductions. After a heavy dinner at Maa Anjaani pav bhaji, we went straight for desserts at Theobroma.

Theobroma wasn’t always my go-to place but it has recently become one. Not only do they serve delicious brownies, their pastries are also pretty good.

Fresh Cream Pineapple Pastry ♥️🔥: A very simple yet delicious pastry. I absolutely love their cream and pineapple filling which makes a perfect combination. It’s not too sweet making it perfect for a post dinner dessert item. Must try even if you don’t enjoy fruit cakes, this will leave you craving for it.

Hazelnut Praline Mousse Cake ♥️: When I am craving a chocolate cake, this is the one I go for. Its delicious!

New York Style Cheesecake ♥️: It was delicious and definitely worth trying.

Sourdough Bread ♥️: Recently I purchased their sourdough bread for sandwiches and after lightly toasting the bread, I was very happy with it’s texture and flavour. They charge 120 for it which makes it extremely valuable for the money spent.

Horrid story to tell about theobroma i c colony giving us a HALF BAKED WET CHEESECAKE!!

So it was my mothers 68th birthday yesterday 30 Nov 2024. I ordered her a surprise cake from the theobroma store thats just 300m from home. We didnt check it as it was a surprise for my mother.

In the evening we opened the cake from the fridge & saw that the CHEESECAKE WAS RUNNY AND LIQUID!!! The letters on the cake were moving, attached pic above.The plastic around couldnt be removed as the cake would overflow!! The baker honestly didnt bake it right. WE SANG HAPPY BIRTHDAY BUT MUMMY DIDNT CUT THE CAKE!!! SEE PHOTO.

What a disappointment to see my mother unable to cut the cake as it was liquid. She was sad, we felt so bad to see her unable to cut the liquid cake. Our guests left without eating cake as well. We were embarrased in front of guests and friends, giving mummy a bad unbaked cake. We went out to dinner anyway & put the cake in fridge to try it out today 1Dec, thinking maybe it needed to set properly. Complaining at 10pm was not a priority as we didnt want to ruin the evening further for mummy.

Today morning 1 Dec we checked it again at 11am, its still sticky, and not set. Its like icecream and stickier. Finally i took pictures today 1 Dec at 12pm after removing the plastic & it fell apart!! I called theobroma to address the issue. After forwarding them pics on whatsapp, i get the response "Thank you for the feedback. We cannot help you as its 24 hours passed"

They expected us to call them in front of our guests last night at 10pm to complain 🤦‍♀️ Very disappointed to say the least. The evening was ruined as mom stood to cut cake & there was no cake as it was liquid. It hadnt set.The baker didnt bake it correctly.

Im a regular customer & yet they didnt have the courtesy to offer to repair the damage done especially given the occasion of a birthday of a senior. Or even return the money. The cake is as it is, see below pic. Its shape changed because it overflowed.

Never will i return back or recommend. Thanks for ruining a birthday. Here i am on my day off, complaining, only to be unheard. Where are your ethics when you managed to ruin a birthday,& yet show no courtesy to customer grievances?

The cake is still at home, uneaten and uncut. What a horrible birthday we had because of theobroma i c colony staff. She will never forget this bad experience.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavesh Mistry

We are beyond thrilled with the amazing experience CHOCOKATES gave us for our 10th Foundation Anniversary celebration at Rightness Personnel Solutions Pvt. Ltd.!

We had a huge challenge — celebrating a decade of success by sending cakes to our entire team and all our valued clients. And CHOCOKATES made it happen flawlessly! The cakes weren’t just delicious; they were beautifully crafted, fresh, and full of joy — perfectly adding sweetness to our milestone celebration.

A special shout-out to Priti Ma’am, the real hero behind this entire operation. Managing logistics for such a large-scale client and employee distribution could have been stressful, but she handled everything with incredible professionalism, warmth, and grace. Every cake was delivered on time, perfectly packed, and exactly as promised — it truly felt like having a world-class event coordinator on our side!

If you’re looking for not just quality cakes but a team that genuinely cares about making your celebration perfect, CHOCOKATES is the one to trust. They didn’t just deliver desserts — they delivered happiness and helped us make our 10-year journey even more memorable. 🎉🎂💛
